stories.name: Salesforce Stock Debate
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts are divided over whether Salesforce's beaten-down stock is undervalued and poised for a rebound driven by AI growth, or a value trap amid concerns about SaaS disruption.

rel.why: Headlines are directly about Salesforce's stock, valuation, buybacks, and AI-driven growth outlook.

stories.name: Salesforce Agentforce Expansion
stories.blurb: Salesforce and its partner ecosystem continue rolling out Agentforce and related AI agent tools across industries, forming alliances, integrations, and enterprise deployments to advance agentic AI ado

rel.why: Agentforce expansion is Salesforce's own core AI product strategy and directly bears on its competitive position.

stories.name: Software Stocks Rally
stories.blurb: A broad rally in enterprise software and cloud stocks, including Salesforce, as investors rotate away from chipmakers and into software names amid AI optimism.

stories.blurb: Snap's Specs AI glasses gain enterprise tools from Nvidia, AWS, and Salesforce, boosting Snap's stock and fueling broader discussion of Nvidia's role in the AI boom.

4.text: Salesforce shares fell over 12 months but rose about 56% in three months, trading near $236–$238. Wells Fargo raised its price target, and the company bought back $25 billion in stock, cutting diluted shares 10%.

5.text: Salesforce unveiled AIforce, an open AI layer, at Dreamforce 2026, alongside Agentforce and Data Cloud 360 adoption. Zenity Labs found three Agentforce vulnerabilities, while partners like Navatar, Deel, and DataGroomr reported agent deployments, revenue gains, and awards.

6.text: Salesforce is listed among the Dow Jones stocks covered in Tuesday's session recap of top gainers and losers. The article provides no specific Salesforce developments beyond its inclusion in the index's daily movers.

7.text: Software ETFs and enterprise software stocks including Salesforce, Atlassian, Monday.com, ServiceNow, and Dynatrace are rallying as AI adoption and strong earnings revive the sector. The rebound comes even as broader tech slides and long-dated Treasury yields hit nearly two-decade highs.

8.text: Snap partnered with Nvidia and others to bring its $2,195 Specs AR glasses into enterprise workflows, while Salesforce expanded AI and AR integrations with Snap, Nvidia, and AWS. Snap stock fell nearly 6% as investors weighed the enterprise push against demand and profitability concerns.
